record.bible_text: Why do the heathen<WH01471> rage<WH07283><WTH8804>, and the people<WH03816> imagine<WH01897><WTH8799> a vain thing<WH07385>? <RF>rage: or, tumultuously assemble<Rf> <RF>imagine: Heb. meditate<Rf>

The kings<WH04428> of the earth<WH0776> set<WH03320><WTH8691> themselves, and the rulers<WH07336><WTH8802> take counsel<WH03245><WTH8738> together<WH03162>, against the LORD<WH03068>, and against his anointed<WH04899>, <FI>saying<Fi> ,
Let us break<WH05423><WH00> their bands<WH04147> asunder<WH05423><WTH8762>, and cast away<WH07993><WTH8686> their cords<WH05688> from us.
He that sitteth<WH03427><WTH8802> in the heavens<WH08064> shall laugh<WH07832><WTH8799>: the Lord<WH0136> shall have them in derision<WH03932><WTH8799>.
Then shall he speak<WH01696><WTH8762> unto them in his wrath<WH0639>, and vex<WH0926><WTH8762> them in his sore displeasure<WH02740>. <RF>vex: or, trouble<Rf>
Yet have I set<WH05258><WTH8804> my king<WH04428> upon my holy<WH06944> hill<WH02022> of Zion<WH06726>. <RF>set: Heb. anointed<Rf> <RF>upon...: Heb. upon Zion, the hill of my holiness<Rf><CM>

I will declare<WH05608><WTH8762> the decree<WH02706>: the LORD<WH03068> hath said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto me, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my Son<WH01121>; this day<WH03117> have I begotten<WH03205><WTH8804> thee. <RF>the decree: or, for a decree<Rf>

Ask<WH07592><WTH8798> of me, and I shall give<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>thee<Fi> the heathen<WH01471> <FI>for<Fi> thine inheritance<WH05159>, and the uttermost parts<WH0657> of the earth<WH0776> <FI>for<Fi> thy possession<WH0272>.
Thou shalt break<WH07489><WTH8799> them with a rod<WH07626> of iron<WH01270>; thou shalt dash them in pieces<WH05310><WTH8762> like a potter's<WH03335><WTH8802> vessel<WH03627>.<CM>
Be wise<WH07919><WTH8685> now therefore, O ye kings<WH04428>: be instructed<WH03256><WTH8734>, ye judges<WH08199><WTH8802> of the earth<WH0776>.
Serve<WH05647><WTH8798> the LORD<WH03068> with fear<WH03374>, and rejoice<WH01523><WTH8798> with trembling<WH07461>.

Kiss<WH05401><WTH8761> the Son<WH01248>, lest he be angry<WH0599><WTH8799>, and ye perish<WH06><WTH8799> <FI>from<Fi> the way<WH01870>, when his wrath<WH0639> is kindled<WH01197><WTH8799> but a little<WH04592>. Blessed<WH0835> <FI>are<Fi> all they that put their trust<WH02620><WTH8802> in him.<CM>
